title: Bank works at the upper reach: two quotes compared
subtitle: Briefing note · 11 November 2026 · Draft
summary: The steering group asked for a second quote for the bank works. It has come in. This note compares the two and asks for one decision.
footer: Bank works at the upper reach

body.title: What I need from you
body.notes:
1. **Choose a contractor** for the bank works, by 18 November 2026.
2. **Agree the start date** of 1 December, or name another.

body.markdown: Both quotes cover the same 400 m of bank. They differ on stone supply.

- The first quote for the bank works, October 2026
- The second quote for the bank works, November 2026
- Minutes of the steering group, 14 October 2026
